text:
alex_m: hey @jana_peopleops quick q — planning a 2-month pilot starting June: split week between SF (Mon-Wed) and Lisbon (Thu-Fri). Home_base stays SF. Do I need to change payroll or benefits? Also how does WFH stipend / coworking reimbursement get prorated for cross-border weeks?
jana_peopleops: thanks Alex! a few quick ones: 1) are you an employee or contractor? 2) total anticipated days in PT per calendar year? 3) will you be paid in USD and keep US bank? :slightly_smiling_face:
alex_m: employee. pilot is ~8 weeks, ~16 days in Lisbon total. will keep USD + US bank. intent is to keep health + 401k in US.
mike_finance: fyi — generally under 90 days we don't cut over payroll. finance needs travel dates to monitor cumulative days tho. stipend proration is handled by monthly payroll team: we pro-rate the monthly WFH allowance based on days remote vs home in that month unless there's a coworking receipt.
iris_payroll: correct — for under ~90 days no payroll jurisdiction change. if visits become habitual and exceed thresholds (183 or local rules) we trigger local payroll registration. i'll flag your record for monitoring. please add exact dates in the travel form.
jana_peopleops: for the WFH stipend options: 1) keep usual WFH stipend (pro-rated if you ask), 2) claim coworking reimbursement (submit receipts via Expensify) — coworking receipts are paid gross and reviewed by finance. if you want the stipend pro-rate, we do that automatically if you declare travel before the pay cycle cutoff.
jenna_benefits: quick note on healthcare — 2 months with home_base in US is fine for your US plan but verify telehealth + any in-country care limits. if you need in-person appointments in PT we can check out-of-network coverage details.
remy_legal: also check visa/immigration — short business/remote trips typically fine, but some countries interpret remote work differently. portugal has a short-stay rule; if you're doing this as personal travel + remote work it's usually okay but don't assume. not legal advice — ping me with dates + intent and i'll confirm.
hr-bot: Reminder: complete the "Short-term Remote Travel" form within 48 hours of booking travel: https://redwood-internal/people/travel-declare — failure to declare may delay stipend/proration.
alex_m: thanks all. two quick follow-ups: 1) coworking — can I just submit a receipt per day and get reimbursed? 2) do i need to ship hardware or can i use my company laptop in Lisbon?
jana_peopleops: coworking: yes submit receipts in Expensify under category COWORK_REIMB, attach dates, and note project. reimbursement back to USD payroll. laptop: short trips — you can travel with company laptop. if you request additional peripherals shipped to PT we need the shipping form + equipment inventory.
mike_finance: action for payroll/finance: if alex declares June 3–July 28 we'll pro-rate stipend for June/July and process coworking receipts if submitted. finance will code to travel ledger 4120.
iris_payroll: i'll monitor travel days and note on your payroll record. if patterns continue beyond pilot we'll re-evaluate nexus.
jana_peopleops: summary/action items: 1) Alex — fill short-term travel form with dates & bank confirmation (hr-bot link). 2) Alex — if claiming coworking, submit receipts in Expensify (category COWORK_REIMB). 3) Finance/Payroll — monitor cumulative foreign days and pro-rate stipend for June/July. 4) Legal — confirm visa nuance if needed. ping me when travel form is done and i'll mark stipend proration. :thumbsup:
alex_m: filed form and attached itinerary. thanks team!
